title: Rioproperty rise text
description: Heading text whose words rise out of their own masks as it scrolls into view, rippling left to right, scrubbed with the scroll; or, for paragraphs, the whole block fades and rises 30px. CSS only.
notes: takes plain text (it splits on spaces)
CSS only: without scroll-driven animations, or with reduced motion, the text simply stands
the masks leave room for ascenders and descenders; leading under ~0.9 may clip accents
name: rioproperty-rise-text

props.name: text
props.description: the text; with split "words" every word rises from its own mask

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render: h2 by default

props.name: split
props.description:
"words": each word rises out of a mask, a ripple from left to right (headings);
"block": the whole text fades and rises 30px (paragraphs)

props.name: distance
props.description: how many px of scroll, after the text enters the window, the rise takes
